openTomorrow: Honestly, no. Not tomorrow anyway. I need to recover and maybe find a workout that's actually at my level. That was way too intense for day one.
secured: I think it means saving your progress or locking in your commitment to the challenge so it's officially recorded in your profile.
freeze: I'm guessing it's a way to pause or skip a day without breaking your streak if something comes up and you can't work out.
selfReported: That's probably when you manually log that you completed a workout instead of the app tracking it automatically, like if you worked out offline.
best: Honestly? Starting it. I felt so motivated and ready before I realized what I was getting into. That first minute felt amazing.
worst: Around minute 15 when I realized I couldn't keep up with everyone else and felt so embarrassed and out of breath. I almost quit right there.
tellFriend: I'd probably tell them to try it, but I'd definitely warn them to start with a beginner level first. Don't be like me and pick something too hard. The app seems really good, just match it to where you actually are.
